name: world-sync-extras
author: Lil Art
description: Optional extras for the World Sync content (1.6.6): entrances from rAthena's towns and fields into the maps World Sync fills (off by default; needs those maps in your client), 740 official NPCs whose logic no server data has yet, placed with their own sprite, name and spot, and @npcplace, a GM command to move any NPC and keep it there. Renewal.
